messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.v1 endpoint p99 latency breach detected (SLO: 500ms). Current p95=2.3s p99=9.1s. Error rate stable. Impact: streaming stalls observed. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/alerts/2245012345 :rotating_light:

sarah_dev: saw the alert, hitting console now. any recent deploys?

michael_oncall: I’m oncall — checking deploys and cache logs. pinging infra.

dinesh_infra: we rolled a prefix-hash change for cache keys about 22m ago (canary). Will pull deploy ID.

sarah_dev: that matches the timing. prefix-hash change would cause massive cache invalidations if rollout touched live pods. we should check hit-rate metrics.

arjun_ml: pulling redis/kvm hit metrics for streaming cluster 7.

dinesh_infra: link to rollout: https://ci.internal/job/rollout/7621, change: prefix-hash v2 -> v3 (hash salt update). Canary was 10% by service tag.

arjun_ml: cache hit-rate for streaming shard set dropped from 86% -> 18% starting at 2245012200. Paging I/O increased 6x.

eva_sre: streaming tails show long stalls tied to paging: logs show repeated EVICT->FETCH cycles and large KV fetch latencies ~1.2s per op.

sarah_dev: this aligns: cache cold starts cause prefix misses and streaming runtime falls back to disk/paging, adding tail latency. mitigation = stop rollout / revert and warm cache.

michael_oncall: can we abort the rollout and flip traffic? who has permission?

dinesh_infra: I can pause the rollout and force old key scheme for the 10% canary. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Rollout 7621 paused by dinesh_infra at 2245012482. Status: PAUSED.

arjun_ml: also recommend temporary prefetch and increase cache TTL for popular prefixes to speed warmup. I can push a config change to the cache-proxy with bypass=false -> prefetch=true.

eva_sre: we should also enable fallback routing: route streaming.v1 to dedicated pool in region-us-west for 10m to reduce customer impact.

sarah_dev: agreed. michael, can you coordinate the reroute and notify product?

michael_oncall: initiating emergency route override to dedicated pool. rate-limit lowered to 80% to reduce load. Doing now.

dinesh_infra: rollback partial completed: canary reverted to v2 at 2245012650. Waiting for cache repop.

arjun_ml: warming in progress: queued top-500 prefixes for prefetch. ETA ~6m.

eva_sre: monitoring: p95 dropped from 2.3s -> 650ms, p99 trending down from 9.1s -> 1.8s. still above SLO but improving.

sarah_dev: customer impact: a handful of larger streaming sessions saw stalls/timeouts. CS notified to triage top customers hitting streaming.v1; no widespread errors but degraded latency for ~3% of requests.

dinesh_infra: follow-up: root cause is change in prefix-hash algorithm that made keys incompatible with existing on-disk cache. The plan going forward: need migration path + dual-key read before full rollout.

michael_oncall: handoff: I’m going off shift in 48m — handing oncall to eva_sre. We need a runbook entry: "prefix-key rollout" with steps: canary size, dual-read, warmup, abort conditions (p95>1s or hit-rate drop >30%).

eva_sre: taking over. will keep monitoring until p99 < 700ms for 30m. I will also open a follow-up postmortem ticket and schedule a short blameless RCA.

sarah_dev: thanks team. action items: (1) formalize dual-key read in cache-proxy (arjun_ml + eng-runtime) (2) add surge-warmup job to prefetch top prefixes (dinesh_infra) (3) update deploy playbook with abort thresholds (product + eng-sre).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> partial (service restored to reduced latency). Incident owner: eva_sre. Severity: Sev2. Follow-up: create RCA ticket #INC-2245.
